issues.issue: False-positive uncited-number flags: all ACR20 percentages are present within the OCR-concatenated citation strings (e.g., 'Placebo2482'→24, '4126140.003'→41, '482811'→48); the deterministic matcher cannot tokenize the packed numbers but values are supported.
False-positive flag: the number '0' is part of the phrase '0-3 months', not an uncited efficacy/safety statistic.
False-positive flags: '9' and '2012' are the date (May 9, 2012), not uncited vote counts; the actual vote tallies (8/2, 10/0, 7/2/1, 2/8) are all in the citation.
False-positive flags: '21' and '2011' are the receipt date (October 21, 2011), which is date-excluded; value=true is correctly inferred from absence of a prior CRL.
